note: The last 64 candidate bytes are interpreted as UTF-32 codepoints and added to the shaping buffer as Arabic base and combining marks.
The Arabic combining mark run is sorted by modified combining class before script-specific mark reordering.
The Arabic shaper's reorder callback receives the in-place normalized buffer and the mark-run bounds.
Input-selected Arabic modifier combining marks advance j, making the reordering range non-empty.
The in-place Arabic reorder path should merge clusters in buffer->info, but it calls the out-buffer merge helper even though the current data is not in buffer->out_info.
merge_out_clusters reads cluster fields from the stale output buffer, producing the uninitialized-value read reported by MSAN.
